children: AEye reported a multi-million-dollar NASA-backed contract for lunar deployment and record commercial engagement with sharply higher revenue.
Secured a binding multi-million-dollar commitment from Lunar Outpost, backed by NASA funding, to deploy Apollo on the Pegasus Lunar Terrain Vehicle.
Signed a development contract with Alive3D to deploy Apollo in sports analytics, expanding into a new commercial vertical.
Commercial activity at a record high: 25 customers taking revenue shipments, 19% increase since Q1; engagements +25%, quotes ~40% QoQ.
Revenue grew ~9x year-over-year and roughly doubled sequentially; first-half 2026 revenue already exceeded full-year 2025.
Company reports substantial cash position, virtually debt free, and appointed Laura Wrisley as Chief Revenue Officer to scale go-to-market.
This is an AI-powered summary. It may contain inaccuracies. Consider verifying important information with the source. Please note this summary is solely based on documents filed with the SEC.

title: AEye secures multi-million NASA-backed lunar contract, reports record commercial engagement and strong revenue growth
